No typical prices changed.\\n\\n### New networks\\n\\n| Network | Change | Source and what it says |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| `exploren` (Exploren) | New: match `exploren`, `engie`; `typicalPerKWh` null, basis `none`; `siteReading` `forbidden` | [The Driven, 8 Apr 2025](https://thedriven.io/2025/04/08/evse-acquires-engies-australian-and-new-zealand-ev-charging-network/): EVSE (Exploren) bought ENGIE's Australian network and moved it into the Exploren app. Exploren's own site is on the do-not-read list, so it wasn't read. |\\n| `wevolt` (Wevolt) | New: match `wevolt`, `electrona`; `typicalPerKWh` null, basis `none`; `siteReading` `unchecked` | [wevolt.com.au/drivers](https://wevolt.com.au/drivers): drivers pay in the Wevolt app; \\\"independent operators set their own prices\\\". [electrona.au]((electrona.au/redacted) Electrona's Tasmanian chargers take a card or the Wevolt app. |\\n\\n### Operators added to existing networks\\n\\n| Operator (fast sites) | Added to | Old → new `match` addition | Evidence |\\n|---|---|---|---|\\n| Yurika (49), Queensland Electric Super Highway (6) | `chargefox` | + `yurika`, `queensland electric super highway` | [Yurika QESH page](https://www.yurika.com.au/capability/qld-electric-super-highway/): \\\"To get charging you'll need the Chargefox App\\\" |\\n| Charging the Regions (25) | `evie` | + `charging the regions` | [CVGA](https://www.cvga.org.au/charging-the-regions.html): \\\"Evie Networks contracted for operation and maintenance of the installed chargers\\\" |\\n| RAA (13) | `chargefox` | + `raa` | [RAA charging stations](https://www.raa.com.au/motor/motoring-services/ev-charging-stations) and The Driven (2 Mar 2023): RAA Charge sites are found, started and paid for in the Chargefox app |\\n| Electric Highway Tasmania (6) | `chargefox` | + `electric highway tasmania` | Several PlugShare listings and forum posts agree: pay with the Chargefox app or card (some sites also take credit cards) |\\n| WA EV Network (4), EV Highway (Horizon Power) (3) | `chargefox` | + `wa ev network`, `horizon power` | Horizon Power fees page (search excerpt; a direct fetch returned 403): \\\"pay via the Chargefox app or credit card\\\", DC $0.60/kWh for 2026/27, the same as Chargefox's current typical price |\\n| Woolworths (4) | `chargefox` | + `woolworths` | [The Driven, 14 May 2025](https://thedriven.io/2025/05/14/australian-ev-charging-platform-partners-with-retail-giants-rewards-program/): Woolworths' own chargers are on the Chargefox app |\\n\\n`updated` is now 2026-11-19. `format.mjs` and `validate.mjs` both pass.\\n\\n### Things to check\\n\\n- **`raa` is a short match string.** It could catch a site whose name happens to contain \\\"raa\\\". I found no conflict, but I couldn't search the charger file for this.\\n- **`woolworths`:** some chargers at Woolworths car parks belong to other networks (for example, an Evie site near a Woolworths). Any of those named \\\"Woolworths...\\\" would get Chargefox's price unless their operator field matches the other network first.\\n- **Charging the Regions:** Wellington Shire says a few of its council sites use Chargefox, not Evie. Most CTR sites are Evie.\\n- **Wevolt `siteReading`:** its robots.txt blocks AI training crawlers (including ClaudeBot) but allows answer agents. Its /terms page wasn't checked, so it's left as `unchecked`.\\n- **Exploren price:** a third-party site lists individual Exploren sites at $0.35–0.70/kWh (checked 24 Oct 2026).
